summary: Wrote a six-phase plan restructuring the five source-store documentation files around the /task -> /orchestrate -> /todo spine. Wave 1 runs three independent file edits in parallel (extensions README table, user-guide.md spine rewrite, research-flow-example.md record-versioning strip); Phase 3 then adds the first-class /orchestrate section plus /project-overview, /please, /zulip and an Extensions section; Phase 4 aligns user-installation.md and docs-README.md; Phase 6 runs the full gate set and redeploys via deploy-headless.sh under a bounded wait. Two research-corrected premises are carried into the plan as explicit decisions: research-flow-example.md needs a prose strip rather than a retarget-or-retire choice, and record 435's file_scope amendment is verify-only.
